dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies participating on the Operating Committee for Export Policy and entities applying for specific export licenses.
dimensions.evidence: Operating Committee for Export Policy (an interagency body within the Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security)

dimensions.assessment: Modifies internal voting requirements and chair authorities for specific export license disputes rather than creating broad public-facing programs.
dimensions.evidence: requires the Operating Committee for Export Policy ... to resolve disputes related to specified matters by majority vote

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply any federal spending, revenue, or broader economic effects.
Amends Section 1763(c) of the Export Control Reform Act of 2018 regarding interagency voting procedures.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Export Control Reform Act of 2018 relating to the review of the interagency dispute resolution process.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change governing federal interagency export review procedures.

missing_information: Estimates of the volume or economic value of export license applications affected by these specific embargo dispute rules.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies administrative dispute resolution rules for export license applications involving countries subject to comprehensive arms embargoes and Russia, shifting decision-making mechanics within an existing interagency committee.
